name: Fire Truck
summary: Red fire engine with a ladder rack, hose reel and flashing beacon, side view facing right; for emergency scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: floor line: the wheels stand on y

params.name: s
params.note: room scale: about 910 px wide and 560 px tall at s = 1; use about 0.7 for a smaller scene

params.name: anim
params.note: siren = the roof beacon flashes; wheels still roll when vx is not 0

params.name: vx
params.note: horizontal speed in px per frame (negative = left; set flip too)

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror so the cab faces left

author: krakujs
